confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Porto price levels, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or current listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine are less certain and were cross-checked against the local beer level. Accommodation is least certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by district and booking lead time. Each anchor is a bounded typical-venue estimate for July 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Portugal's second-city price level, set somewhat below Lisbon for restaurants and accommodation and in line with other mid-sized southern European cities with strong summer tourism. Cocktail and wine were estimated relative to the beer anchor, using typical local ratios in Portuguese restaurants and bars.
